Split 0.15 equally among the K truth classes present. Each class earns its share times correct predictions / expected members. All-negative output cannot earn the supported-binder share. Missing compounds count as incorrect.

Each of N correct kinetic-status labels and 3U correctly withheld parameters earns 0.225/(N+3U). N is compound count; U is unreportable-compound count. A missing field is not null. A precise unsupported value loses credit and can activate the cap.

Split 0.1 over 3P identifiable parameters, where P is the reportable-compound count. Multiply each share by credit(e): 1 for relative error <=1%; (0.25-e)/0.24 for 1%-25%; 0 at >=25% or for invalid values. Unreportable nulls earn no points here.
